## d172afae0ee5

Audited source SHA-256:
`9c4298adc569c3da9b2cabf039f426338b2bfd87353087ac78a2366d9d1345da`.
The strict battery completed with 7 green and 5 failed stages: lint,
defect_lint, profile_floor, semantic_gate and override. Summary:
`checks/audit/d172afae0ee5-battery/checks/d172afae0ee5_audit_battery_summary.json`.

### AUD-D172-01 — reproduced canonical-shape coverage collapse (important)

The canonical visible inputs contain five normalized object occupancies:
`10/10/11`, `111/010`, `011/110`, `101/111`, and `11/10`. Across seeds 0–19,
the generator emitted only the fixed `10/10/11` L-tetromino. This is not merely
low random diversity: `generate()` hard-codes that shape, while the rule moves
an arbitrary cropped object. The profile-floor stage also found no exact
canonical-profile hit in the hard band. Evidence:
`checks/audit/audit_probe.json` and
`checks/audit/d172afae0ee5-battery/checks/d172afae0ee5_audit_profile_floor.log`.

**Impact:** lessons can teach “move this one L shape” rather than the intended
shape-independent crop-and-paste operation, and the hard band lacks required
canonical support. No repair was made.

### AUD-D172-02 — reproduced dead/contradictory public controls (important)

Valid `palette_kind=warm` versus `cool` and valid `texture=warm` versus `cool`
produce byte-identical grids for the same seed/sample. The strict override gate
also reports declared grid domains that are rejected by the difficulty-local
`draw_int` ranges, accepted unknown keys, and thousands of requested/observed
mismatches. Float seeds, float sample indices and negative sample indices are
accepted. Evidence:
`checks/audit/audit_probe.json`,
`checks/audit/d172afae0ee5-battery/checks/d172afae0ee5_audit_override.log`, and
`checks/audit/d172afae0ee5-battery/checks/d172afae0ee5_audit_defect_lint.log`.

**Impact:** advertised controls are not falsifiable or reproducible as declared,
and malformed calls silently enter the sampling stream. No repair was made.

### AUD-D172-03 — domain question: no executable teaching contract

The semantic gate fails because no witness/rival/lesson-identifiability contract
is declared. I did not establish a specific rival lesson that survives all
current demonstrations, so this is recorded as an unclosed domain question,
not as proof of ambiguity. Evidence:
`checks/audit/d172afae0ee5-battery/checks/d172afae0ee5_audit_semantic_gate.log`.
